title: Autopilot in the AI IDE chat

clauses.text: A multi-step goal runs to a summary without you typing

steps.do: In a workspace chat, set the approval chip to Autopilot (its third mode, Ctrl+Q as the row names). Give a multi-step goal and type nothing else.
steps.expect: The steps run one after another and the chat ends with a summary of done and blocked rows, files changed and commands run.

clauses.text: Typing pauses Autopilot and Resume carries on

steps.do: While it runs, type a message (this pauses it), then press Resume.
steps.expect: It pauses on typing and Resume continues from the same step.
